::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: An application that prepares non-clinical image files and metadata for BigPicture. It removes sensitive information, converts the metadata to the [metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd), and uploads.

Who it's for
: Non-clinical data contributors, through the non-clinical node.

Provided by
: Deciphex. Installed at your site.

Before you start
: You are onboarded as a BigPicture data contributor.

How to get access
: Write to the Service Desk. Deciphex installs the Data transporter for you and writes the metadata scripts your data needs.

Guides
: [None public]{.proto-none}

Terms and privacy
: [Only the general BigPicture terms]{.proto-none}

Support
